form.label: CMDB changes
form.description: Search by hostname, OS and detected date (this tab has no CVE data). Servers whose CMDB status, environment or device category changed. Built hourly by comparing cmdb_assets.csv with the previous snapshot (scheduled searches "Rapid7 CVE - CMDB change tracker" and "CMDB snapshot"). Mapping, mismatches and coverage are on the Asset management tab. INACTIVE and DECOMMISSION servers are hidden from the other pages of this app and never rescanned.

search.query: | inputlookup r7_cmdb_changes_lookup | eval detected_e=strptime(replace(detected,"Z",""),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") | where detected_e>=relative_time(now(),"$range$") | eval host=upper(host) | lookup cmdb_assets.csv host OUTPUT cmdb_status AS status_now cmdb_class AS cmdb_class_now cmdb_env AS cmdb_env_now device_category AS category_now | eval cmdb_class=cmdb_class_now, cmdb_env=cmdb_env_now | `r7_env_label` | eval change=case(change_type="environment","Environment changed", change_type="status_inactive","Status → INACTIVE / DECOMMISSION", change_type="status_active","Status → WORKING_ACTIVE", change_type="new_ci","New in CMDB", change_type="category","Device category changed", true(),"Status changed")
| stats dc(host) as servers by change | sort - servers

single.title: INACTIVE / DECOMMISSION but still answering Rapid7 (last 7 days)

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | search cmdb_status IN ("INACTIVE","DECOMMISSION") | eval ls=strptime(replace(last_scan,"Z",""),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") | where ls>=relative_time(now(),"-7d") | stats dc(asset_id) as servers

| search change="$change$" | where like(lower(host), lower("%$c_host$%")) AND ("$c_from$"="" OR substr(detected,1,10)>="$c_from$") | join type=left host [search `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` earliest=-3d | dedup asset_id | eval host=upper(replace(hostname,"\..*$$","")) | stats first(os) as os by host] | where like(lower(coalesce(os,"")), lower("%$c_os$%")) | table detected host os change field from to status_now env_label category_now | sort - detected
